degree_rationale: The pearl in the sea — formed from rain falling sweet into the oyster, with multiple drops making multiple pearls; analogously the soul which the Mind of Light purifies, but is disturbed by zodia from above and food from below. Long parable illumining the formation of the soul-pearl.
direction_rationale: Wisdom showing soul-formation through the pearl-parable — the bright naturalistic illustration of how purity is formed and disturbed.
grand_man_function: Natural soul-pearl illumination — the parable of forming purity.
title: How the cosmos is fashioned after a man's body / pearl in the sea
